meaning.zh:
“得到批准” 或 “获得许可”。

这个短语来源于寻求授权或许可后的绿灯信号，可以比喻为开车时得到可以继续前进的信号灯。在工作环境中，它通常意味着某人或者某个项目获得了上司或相关方的批准，可以开始或继续进行。
meaning.en: This idiom originates from the concept of receiving a green light or signal to proceed, similar to traffic signals. In a work context, it means that someone or a project has received approval from a superior or relevant authority to start or continue.

lines.en: We got the *go-ahead* to start the new project next week.
lines.zh: 我们已经获得了下周开始新项目的批准。

lines.en: She just needs the *go-ahead* from her manager to make the changes.
lines.zh: 她只需要得到她经理的批准就能进行更改。

lines.en: Once we get the *go-ahead*, we can start the construction work.
lines.zh: 一旦我们得到许可，就可以开始施工。
